title: デビュー戦の後に・そして明星は

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satisfaction and joy fill Admire Vega's heart after her incredible debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She also feels relief, having managed to begin making amends with her sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wanting to dedicate even greater victories to her sister, she suggests the Hopeful Stakes as her next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I agree with her, and we begin a training regimen even more intense than before.
